{
  "type_map": {
    "dur": "float",
    "proto": "nominal",
    "service": "nominal",
    "state": "nominal",
    "spkts": "integer",
    "dpkts": "integer",
    "sbytes": "integer",
    "dbytes": "integer",
    "rate": "float",
    "sttl": "integer",
    "dttl": "integer",
    "sload": "float",
    "dload": "float",
    "sloss": "integer",
    "dloss": "integer",
    "sinpkt": "float",
    "dinpkt": "float",
    "sjit": "float",
    "djit": "float",
    "swin": "integer",
    "stcpb": "integer",
    "dtcpb": "integer",
    "dwin": "integer",
    "tcprtt": "float",
    "synack": "float",
    "ackdat": "float",
    "smean": "integer",
    "dmean": "integer",
    "trans_depth": "integer",
    "response_body_len": "integer",
    "ct_srv_src": "integer",
    "ct_state_ttl": "integer",
    "ct_dst_ltm": "integer",
    "ct_src_dport_ltm": "integer",
    "ct_dst_sport_ltm": "integer",
    "ct_dst_src_ltm": "integer",
    "is_ftp_login": "binary",
    "ct_ftp_cmd": "integer",
    "ct_flw_http_mthd": "integer",
    "ct_src_ltm": "integer",
    "ct_srv_dst": "integer",
    "is_sm_ips_ports": "binary"
  },
  "constraints": [
    {
      "id": "R1",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['dur'] == 0) | np.isclose(df['sload'], (df['sbytes'] * 8) / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5)"
      ],
      "features": ["sload", "sbytes", "dur"],
      "rationale": "Sload is defined as source bits per second, so it equals sbytes*8/dur."
    },
    {
      "id": "R2",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['dur'] == 0) | np.isclose(df['dload'], (df['dbytes'] * 8) / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5)"
      ],
      "features": ["dload", "dbytes", "dur"],
      "rationale": "Dload is defined as destination bits per second, so it equals dbytes*8/dur."
    },
    {
      "id": "R3",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['spkts'] == 0) | (df['smean'] == (df['sbytes'] // df['spkts']))",
        "(df['spkts'] == 0) | (df['smean'] == np.round(df['sbytes'] / df['spkts']).astype(int))"
      ],
      "features": ["smean", "sbytes", "spkts"],
      "rationale": "smean is mean packet size from source, so it is sbytes/spkts, possibly integer division or rounded."
    },
    {
      "id": "R4",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['dpkts'] == 0) | (df['dmean'] == (df['dbytes'] // df['dpkts']))",
        "(df['dpkts'] == 0) | (df['dmean'] == np.round(df['dbytes'] / df['dpkts']).astype(int))"
      ],
      "features": ["dmean", "dbytes", "dpkts"],
      "rationale": "dmean is mean packet size from destination, so it is dbytes/dpkts, possibly integer division or rounded."
    },
    {
      "id": "R5",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.isclose(df['tcprtt'], df['synack'] + df['ackdat'], rtol=1e-5)"
      ],
      "features": ["tcprtt", "synack", "ackdat"],
      "rationale": "tcprtt is defined as the sum of synack and ackdat."
    },
    {
      "id": "R6",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['dur'] == 0) | np.isclose(df['rate'], (df['spkts'] + df['dpkts']) / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5)",
        "(df['dur'] == 0) | np.isclose(df['rate'], (df['sbytes'] + df['dbytes']) / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5)",
        "(df['dur'] == 0) | np.isclose(df['rate'], (df['sbytes'] + df['dbytes']) * 8 / df['dur'], rtol=1e-5)"
      ],
      "features": ["rate", "spkts", "dpkts", "sbytes", "dbytes", "dur"],
      "rationale": "rate is undocumented; plausible definitions include total packets per second, total bytes per second, or total bits per second."
    }
  ]
}
